prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept; original fan-made static enemy sprite for a 2D Aliens-inspired game.
Generate ONE full-body Kenner/NECA Series 10 QUEEN FACEHUGGER, a single creature only, on a genuinely transparent RGBA background.
Reference roles: reference image 1 is a browser screenshot of the manufacturer's NECA 51621 Facehuggers1 product photograph. Use ONLY the LARGE Queen Facehugger on the RIGHT as the anatomical reference. Ignore the smaller companion on the left, white photo background, and browser surround. References 2, 3 and 4 are existing project Gorilla, Rhino and Panther sprites: STYLE, surface detail, sharp edges and lighting references ONLY; do not inherit their bodies, heads, horns, limbs or tails.
Identity lock: the licensed Kenner tribute Queen Facehugger shown in reference 1; NOT the ordinary film Facehugger, NOT the Royal Facehugger from Alien 3, NOT an adult Alien Queen or a humanoid Warrior.
Anatomy observed in the primary photograph: a low squat oval crab-like central body, black ridged shell plates on top, dark scarlet red biomechanical folds under the shell; eight long thin black articulated finger-like legs in four matching pairs, extending laterally in a spider-like supporting stance; leathery muted red/pink membrane panels stretched BETWEEN adjoining leg bases on each side, like the reference, not separate wings; one very long flexible segmented tail starting at the REAR of the central body, red and black vertebral ridges, tapering continuously to the reference's small flattened red pointed tip. No extra tail, no face, no eyes, no tall skull dome, no humanoid hands, no pincers, no stinger bulb.
Composition: elevated three-quarter side view suitable for a 2D ground enemy, creature front toward SCREEN RIGHT, tail trailing behind to SCREEN LEFT then curling gently upward. Standing on its leg tips, stable grounded resting-ready pose, all eight legs readable with natural depth overlaps. Full tail and all leg tips entirely inside canvas. Body sufficiently large to read at game scale; centered total silhouette occupies about 75-80 percent of canvas width and height, at least 8 percent clean transparent margin on every edge. No crop, no contact with image border.
Style: match the supplied project's detailed polished 3D-sculpt/concept-render sprite style, carefully modeled alien anatomy, crisp biomechanical ridges, controlled glossy black carapace, scarlet/red body, restrained pale-red membranes and subtle neutral/cool edge light. Neutral studio illumination with clear form, not neon. It must look like a living fictional creature rendered for the game, not a photograph of plastic action figure joints, packaging or a display base.
Output: one isolated complete static creature, transparent background, clean alpha edges, no environmental floor or cast shadow, no scene, no props, no host, no injury, no gore, no text, no label, no logo, no watermark, no extra creatures, no sprite sheet. This is a reference-guided fan adaptation, not an official asset extraction or a certified 1:1 replica.
